column1: # OpenClaw triage targets — one row per (repo, project) pair.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with "#" or empty lines are ignored.
# The watcher polls each repo for new issues and routes triage output
# (Pts + Priority) into the matching Project v2.
# Columns:
#   1. repo            — "OWNER/NAME"
#   2. project_id      — Project v2 GraphQL node id (PVT_*)
#   3. prio_field_id   — Priority single-select field id (PVTSSF_*)
#   4. pts_field_id    — Story Points single-select field id (PVTSSF_*)
#   5. stack_hint      — short English description, injected into the
#                        triage prompt so Kimi has stack context. Tabs
#                        not allowed inside (use spaces).
# To add a new target:
#   1. Look up project + field ids:
#        gh api graphql -f query='query { node(id:"PVT_xxx") { ... on ProjectV2 { fields(first:30) { nodes { __typename ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { id name } } } } } }'
#   2. Add a row below.
#   3. The watcher's next tick (≤15 min) will start polling. First run
#      bootstraps the watermark for the new repo (no retroactive triage).
# Field-id audit log:
#   2026-04-27 — added Rubberfit-Desktop (project 10) after mirroring
#   project 9's P3 + Story Points scale onto it.
